title: Test procedures for amplifiers and preamplifiers for semiconductor detectors for ionizing radiation
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11645) covers Test procedures for amplifiers and preamplifiers for semiconductor detectors for ionizing radiation. This Indian Standard, which is identical with IEC Pub 340 (1979) `Test procedures for amplifiers and preamplifiers for semiconductor detectors for ionizing radiation' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), was adopted by the Indian Standards lnstitutton on the recommendation of the Nuclear Instrumentation Sectional Committee and aoproval of the Electronics and Telecommunication .Division Council.
